versions.content: {DRAFT} The Ethernet Interface Module shall share the MACsec Operational status between Ethernet Interface Controllers sharing a physical or virtual controlled port. An Ethernet Interface controller shall trigger the MKA Module to start the MKA sequence in a port with MKA_LinkStateChange after receiving the "Mode Indication" from the Switch or Transceiver with the corresponding function EthIf_- SwitchPortModeIndication or EthIf_TrcvModeIndication .
